upstream.description: Cross-surface personal memory system exposed as a remote MCP server (Cloudflare Workers + D1).

classification.analysis: memory-bridge-mcp is a personal, cross-surface memory system exposed as a remote MCP server on Cloudflare Workers + D1, GitHub OAuth-gated to a single allowlisted user, reachable from claude.ai and Claude Code. It provides an eight-tool surface (ping, write, search, get, list_staged, update, delete, triage) implementing a staged-then-triaged write lifecycle so uncertain memories don't silently pollute the store, plus a documented boundary rule against its companion narrative vault (second-brain-template). Built on Cloudflare's official remote-mcp-github-oauth template with Vitest tests run against real D1 via Miniflare rather than mocks, it targets a single power user who wants durable atomic-fact recall shared across multiple AI agent surfaces.

use_cases.title: Give multiple AI agent surfaces (claude.ai, Claude Code) shared durable memory of facts and decisions
Stage uncertain memory writes for later human triage instead of guessing a category
Self-host a single-user, GitHub-OAuth-gated MCP memory server on Cloudflare Workers
Reference a real-D1-tested pattern for a remote MCP server built on Cloudflare's OAuth template
